units.title: Vector relation among opposite side-midpoint chords
units.statement: For consecutive side midpoints U,V,W,X,Y,Z of a convex hexagon, vector UX plus vector WZ equals vector VY. The first two vectors are nonparallel, so their lengths and the length VY satisfy strict triangle inequalities.
steps: Write each side midpoint as the average of its endpoints
Add the coordinate differences for UX and WZ
Use strict convexity and the crossing of chords UX and WZ to exclude parallel vectors
